plan.name: v1.8.0-economics
plan.info: Major economics rebalancing for 10,000x token multiplier - updates relay fees, mint quantity, tier pricing, and gov deposits

title: Upgrade: v1.8.0-economics
summary:
Phase 2 of the Economics v2.0 upgrade. This upgrade rebalances all economic parameters for the 10,000x token multiplier applied in Phase 1.

Core module changes:
- RelayMinGasPrice: 25 → 5000 (now umirage per gas, removes /1000 divisor)
- RelayMaxGasFee: 5,000 → 500,000,000 (500 MIRAGE cap per tx)
- SubscriptionReservePercent: 40% → 80% (20% burned, 80% to gas reserve)
- MintQuantity: 100,000 → 350,000,000 (350 MIRAGE per 10min)
- Tier 1 (Trusted): 10M → 100B umirage ($1/mo at $0.00001/MIRAGE)
- Tier 2 (Established): 20M → 200B umirage ($2/mo)
- Tier 3 (Distinguished): 30M → 300B umirage ($3/mo)

Governance module changes:
- min_deposit: 10M → 500B umirage ($5 at $0.00001/MIRAGE)
- expedited_min_deposit: 10M → 1T umirage ($10)

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to the v1.8.0 binary AND set minimum-gas-prices = "5000umirage" in app.toml BEFORE the upgrade height. The node will fail to start if this is not configured correctly.

See docs/economics_v2_upgrade.md for the complete upgrade plan.
